result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two answers are very similar: both have a name field at the top, filter tabs, cards showing open spots and a full-width Sign up button. B is slightly ahead because it shows each open spot as a labelled slot and says plainly that it will remember the name on this phone. A puts an × on every volunteer's name, which seems to let anyone remove other people. Neither screenshot shows a full shift, undo after dropping out, or the state after signing up, so those items are scored conservatively. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two screenshots are close: each has a name field at the top, an overall progress bar, filters, per-shift open counts and large Sign up buttons. A edges ahead because it shows filled and open spots as clear slots and says outright that the name is remembered on the phone. B puts a small × on every volunteer's name, which looks like anyone could remove anyone else and is a small tap target. Neither screenshot shows a full shift or an undo after dropping out, so items 3, 4 and 6 are scored on limited evidence.
